name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Plex artwork repair: existing and newly federated movies now cache the exact poster selected on the source Plex server, refresh when that poster changes, and keep native IDs and artwork revisions bound to the correct source when duplicate titles span multiple Plex servers. Poster credentials remain server-side and watch history is preserved.
